card.name: Inside cardiology trial and society names
card.fires_on: Words inside names of heart or stroke trials and organizations, such as the SPARCL trial title or the American Heart Association's Scientific Sessions. It fires on small words like "in" and on the opening bracket within these names.

modes.label: SPARCL trial title
modes.description: Words and punctuation inside the full name Stroke Prevention by Aggressive Reduction in Cholesterol Levels (SPARCL).

modes.description: Words in the American Heart Association's Scientific Sessions.

modes.label: Other cardiovascular text
modes.description: Scattered spots in cardiovascular trial or news text, such as a title before a name or a number of trial patients.

card.writes: It pushes toward heart and cholesterol words, which fits the heart-related names it sits inside.
card.plain: It lights up inside the names of heart and stroke trials and groups, expecting a heart or cholesterol word next.
